# x402 URI Codec

> Percent-encode, decode, or normalize URI components (UTF-8 safe) with optional extra safe characters. Deterministic. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/codec – service info
- POST /api/codec – paid encode / decode / normalize

## Pricing

~0.002 – 0.006 USDC per call (default max 0.006 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "text": "hello world / café?",
  "action": "encode",
  "options": {
    "safe": "/"
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "results": [
    { "input": "hello world / café?", "output": "hello%20world%20/%20caf%C3%A9%3F" }
  ],
  "meta": { "count": 1, "action": "encode", "safe": "/" }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents safely building query strings, path segments, or canonicalizing URLs before hashing / signing / downstream HTTP calls.
